registered: 2026-10-12, before any result of this test was seen
source: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018), Market intraday momentum, J. Financial Economics; FX/commodity analogues (e.g. Elaut, Froemmel & Lampaert 2018)

rules.IDX_IM: US indices (US500, US100, US30 hourly futures): signal = return from the previous New York 16:00 close to the 10:00 New York close of the same day; at the 15:00 New York close take position sign(signal); exit at the 16:00 New York close. One trade per index per day.
rules.LDN_IM: Gold, silver, oil and 11 FX pairs (hourly): same rule on the London session: signal = previous 16:00 London close to 09:00 London close; trade 15:00 -> 16:00 London close (the hour holding the 16:00 London fix).

costs: 0.01% of price per round trip (index, gold and major FX CFD spreads are 0.007-0.015%)
samples: first half vs second half of the available dates (indices from 2024-05, FX from 2023-12)
pass: per group: mean net return > 0 in BOTH halves and pooled t >= 2 (t on the daily group portfolio: markets on the same day are correlated)
